hints.title: Dual Inversion for Queue Ordering
hints.text: Reversing an ordered sequence once inverts its order; reversing it a second time restores the original arrival order. How can two lifo containers transfer elements to provide first-in first-out access?

hints.title: Input and Output Stacks
hints.text: Maintain an in_stack for new arrivals and an out_stack for extractions. Push elements directly to in_stack.

hints.title: Lazy Transfer on Pop or Peek
hints.text: When out_stack is empty, pop all elements from in_stack and push them to out_stack. The oldest element is now on top of out_stack ready for O(1) amortized extraction.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(1) amortized for pop and peek, O(1) worst-case for push
variables: N: total number of elements queued
complexity.notes: Each element is pushed and popped at most twice throughout its lifecycle.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Transferring all elements back and forth on every push yields quadratic O(N) cost per push.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Amortized transfer only when out_stack empties yields average constant time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formal amortized analysis explaining why each element experiences at most two stack pushes and two stack pops.
